title: MediaFile
description: A single downloadable media file as delivered by the OfflineMediaDownloader backend (API Gateway wire shape). Fixture pool for OMD previews (S98); numeric fields are raw wire values (bytes, seconds), never display-formatted strings.

fileId.description: Stable backend identifier for the file.

publishDate.description: Publish date in YYYYMMDD format (API) or ISO-8601 (push notifications).

url.description: Download URL for the media asset.

description.description: Longer descriptive text shown on the detail screen.

authorName.description: Display name of the content author or channel.

contentType.description: MIME type of the media asset.

status.title: MediaFileStatus
status.description: Download lifecycle status. Wire values match the OMD FileStatus enum raw values ('pending' is lowercase because push notifications send it lowercase).

viewCount.description: Number of views at the source platform.

thumbnailUrl.description: URL to the media thumbnail image.
